description_en: Call this operation to submit a dynamic image job for asynchronous processing
description_zh: 调用本接口提交媒体动图作业，开始异步处理
name: SubmitDynamicImageJob

parameters.description_en:
The video ID. You can get the video ID in the following ways:

- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.

- The value of the `VideoId` parameter returned by the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation.

- The value of the `VideoId` parameter returned by the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation, which you can call after the video is uploaded.
parameters.description_zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：

- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
